title: What We Saw (HKLGFF 2026)
synopsis:
Hong Kong Premiere

 

In an era where daily life is inseparable from artificial intelligence, can what we see really be the whole truth?

 

At a school under constant A.I. surveillance, Mujin, a newly appointed teacher, is handsome yet somewhat naïve. There, he meets Soyu, a brooding student who shares his passion for art. Mujin becomes deeply captivated by Soyu’s artistic talent, and a brief moment of physical contact between them unexpectedly sets in motion a complicated teacher-student relationship.

 

Told in two parts, Mujin’s memory and Soyu’s memory, the film reconstructs the same events through two radically different lenses. In the end, do we choose to believe the truth as determined by AI, or trust the instincts of human nature?
